title_sq: !!OKAZION!! Dublex 3+1+3WC+Verande ne Shitje tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2 (ID 4131477)
description_sq:
OKAZION!! Duplex 3+1+3 + verande te Kodra e Diellit 2 per shitje!
Apartamenti ndodhet katet 2 dhe 3 te nje objekti 7 katesh, ku hyrja e duplexit eshte ne katin 1. Me siperfaqe totale prej 240 m2, apartamenti organizohet:
– kati 1: siperfaqe 34.8 m2, 1 tualet dhe 1 depo
– kati 2: siperfaqe 84.15 m2, 1 sallon, 1 kuzhine gatimi dhe ngrenie, 1 dhome gjumi, verande 50 m2
– kati 3: siperfaqe 71.96 m2, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete

Apartamenti shitet pjeserisht i mobiluar.
Shitet 300.000 euro
title_en: !!HOPE!! Duplex 3+1+3WC+Verande for sale at Residence Kodra e Diellit 2 (ID 4131477)
description_en: BARGAIN!! Duplex 3+1+3 + veranda in Kodra e Diellit 2 for sale! The apartment is located on the 2nd and 3rd floors of a 7-story building, where the entrance to the duplex is on the 1st floor. With a total area of 240 m2, the apartment is organized: - 1st floor: 34.8 m2 area, 1 toilet and 1 storage room - 2nd floor: 84.15 m2 area, 1 living room, 1 cooking and dining kitchen, 1 bedroom, veranda 50 m2 - floor 3: surface area 71.96 m2, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms The apartment is fully invested, offering a comfortable living. The property includes new electrical and plumbing installations, thermal and acoustic insulation, modern toilets with quality equipment, new tiling/flooring, as well as a multisplit air conditioning system that covers the entire space. Orientation from the east offers fantastic views of Dajti and natural lighting. The apartment is sold partially furnished. For sale 300,000 euros
